rules.title: Asset control language
rules.interpretation: May indicate logic capable of restricting, freezing, or reassigning value. A match is not proof that the capability exists or is consensus-enforced.

rules.title: Privileged override language
rules.interpretation: May indicate a privileged control path. Review key scope, activation conditions, and whether the path affects consensus or only local operation.

rules.title: History override language
rules.interpretation: May indicate local administrative tools or consensus-affecting history controls. Context determines which.

rules.title: Trusted state shortcut
rules.interpretation: May indicate a validation shortcut or bootstrap trust assumption. Determine whether it changes accepted consensus or only validation performance.

rules.title: Remote policy control
rules.interpretation: May indicate rules or behavior controlled outside the local binary. Review authentication, failover, and scope.
